coverage_limits: Only the supplied allowed_sources, supplied law/template, and supplied legacy facts were used; no external search, other conversation, or unsupplied judgment text was used.
Legacy facts are treated as fallible model proposals as instructed; this output links them to literal supplied TEST propositions rather than re-extracting the judgment.
A SUPPORT direction means the cited fact supports the literal test proposition at its recorded statement status; it does not mean the overall eviction ground is established.
Claimed and denied propositions remain allegations or denials. No supplied lower-court factual finding or independently inspected original evidence record is present in legacy_facts.evidence.
F2 and F6 concern whether a wine or bear shop is being run; no separate link is proposed because that fact, without more, is not itself one of the supplied literal legal tests.

No identity is inferred merely from similar names, role labels, capitalization variants, or equal entity IDs. In particular, the materials do not establish E1 'respondent' as E4 'respondents', E2 'Wine merchant' as E7 'Wine Merchant', or either of those as E6 'DTTDC'.
The stated permission of deceased landlord Sheikh Mohd. Yusuf is not described as written. Unknown form is therefore not treated as opposition to DRC_SUBLETTING_C05.

The stated license basis does not by itself resolve parting with possession because the supplied law makes retained legal possession or whole ouster material; F11 separately asserts retained legal possession for the DTTDC/shop account.
The date 'since 1985' is attached to shop operation or license use and cannot, without inference, be treated as the date of a legally relevant disposition.

Premises labels vary among 'premises under the tenancy', 'premises in dispute', 'suit premises', 'tenanted shop', and 'shop'; the supplied snippets do not expressly establish complete cross-span scope identity.
No supplied law allocates burdens or proof standards, and no such allocation is inferred.
